description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS file, and the App component, then sets up the root rendering with strict mode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root to enable rendering of React components.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element tree into the root DOM node.
